Manual Mode Guide

  1. Choose an actionSelect one of the currently legal actions for the active Pokémon.
  2. Watch the battle updateHP, Energy and the Timeline update after each resolved action.
  3. Undo a changeUse Undo to return to the state before the latest manual edit.
  4. Explore an alternativeCreate a new branch to test a different decision without losing the original scenario.
  5. Resume automaticallyUse Resume Automatically to let the simulator continue from the current canonical state.

Back to Simulation returns to the regular simulator view while preserving the current battle context.
